conditionsBeforeRootExecution: Root independently confirms the exact source commit CI success and retains that observation.
Root holds exclusive use of the selected Cargo target and ensures no competing Cargo/rustc process for these outputs; this receipt does not grant a shared-compute or native engine lease.
Execute only the two exact command-B phases through the pinned launcher, retaining actual argv, interpreter/environment observation, stream files, exit outcomes and opening/closing vectors.
Any command/source/resource/launcher byte change requires refreshed verification; failed or incomplete outcomes must not be treated as successful realization.

After success independently inspect the actual binary descriptor/format and complete metadata against the public backend03 schema, 48 unique capability IDs and selected source before later conformance work.

limits: Approval is for local offline release and metadata production, not a qualified compiler realization, full corpus, package/index publication, installed profile or native SQL support.

1800-second deadline and16MiB per-stream limit apply to subprocess capture. Source/resource hashing and binary copying are streaming custody operations over the reviewed cooperative regular-file inputs, not an adversarial filesystem or full whole-wrapper real-time guarantee.

Complete Cargo target/dependency caches, SDK contents and host dynamic-library closure are not inventoried. Observed clang/ld/SDKSettings do not prove a future linker invocation; no hermetic or deterministic-build claim.
Metadata 48-capability expectation is source inspection until the actual phase output is produced and independently validated.
Historical command A remains retained with its old launcher descriptor and must not be executed with the revised launcher; B is the authorized exact successor.
resolvedFindings: Closing source/resource verification now runs after capture failure/cancellation as well as success, preserving a body primary if closing verification fails.
Capture retains the first cleanup exception, including KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit, when there is no body primary; subsequent cleanup still runs.
